## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` — no functional change
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `build` / `ci` / `chore`
- [ ] Breaking change (describe it in "Notes for reviewers")

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm compile` passes
- [ ] New/changed behavior has tests
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and `version` were bumped (if this ships a release)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README.md / README.pt-BR.md / `notes/`)
